name: Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT
briefDescription: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, provides financial assistance to Nomadic and De-notified Tribe students for pursuing higher education in self-financed colleges.
descriptionMd: The scheme "Scholarship for Self Finance Colleges Students of NT/DNT" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to support students belonging to Nomadic Tribes and De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT) categories in accessing quality education in self-financed colleges by reducing the financial burden. Through this scheme, financial assistance of up to ₹50,000/- is provided to cover tuition fees, registration charges, education fees, and other scholarship-related expenses for students enrolled in self-financed colleges. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, and seeks to empower NT/DNT students with improved access to higher education opportunities.
benefitsMd: - **Financial Assistance:** Up to ₹50,000/- for tuition fee, registration fee, education fee, and other scholarship-related charges.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the NT/DNT (Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes) category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a self-financed college in Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) or equivalent examination. 1. The applicant’s individual and family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The Institute must be certified by the government.
